messages.text:
The Python file compiles and the launcher is present.

I’m switching to behavior probes now: small CSV fixtures, running both the official binary and the port with identical argv, and comparing exit code/stdout/stderr byte-for-byte.

commands.commandLine:
"C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command "@'
import subprocess, pathlib, os, sys, tempfile, textwrap
root=pathlib.Path.cwd(); ref=pathlib.Path(root/'REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip(); port=[sys.executable,str(root/'xsv_port.py')]
td=root/'tmp_probe'; td.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(td/'in.csv').write_text('h1,h2,h3\\nabcdefg,a,a\\na,abc,z\\n', encoding='utf-8')
(td/'sel.csv').write_text('h1,h2,h[]3,h4,h1\\na,b,c,d,e\\n', encoding='utf-8')
(td/'freq.csv').write_text('h1,h2\\na,z\\na,y\\na,y\\nb,z\\n,z\\n(NULL),x\\n', encoding='utf-8')
cmds=[['count','in.csv'],['headers','in.csv'],['select','h1-h2','sel.csv'],['slice','--start','1','--end','2','in.csv'],['search','"'^a'"','in.csv'],['sort','--select','h2','in.csv'],['table','in.csv'],['fmt','--quote-always','in.csv'],['frequency','--limit','0','freq.csv'],['stats','--everything','freq.csv']]
for args in cmds:
    rr=subprocess.run([ref]+args,cwd=td,capture_output=True)
    pp=subprocess.run(port+args,cwd=td,capture_output=True)
    ok=(rr.returncode,rr.stdout,rr.stderr)==(pp.returncode,pp.stdout,pp.stderr)
    print(args, 'OK' if ok else 'BAD')
    if not ok:
        print('ref',rr.returncode,rr.stdout,rr.stderr)
        print('port',pp.returncode,pp.stdout,pp.stderr)
'@ | python -"
